This is a wonderful truth, that all who believe in Jesus are not condemned by God (Romans 8:1). There are many people in the world, that truly believe that if you are a good person, and don’t do any really bad sins, then you will be let into heaven when you die. This is not what the bible teaches, as it is very clear that you must be born again before you can be saved (John 3:3). When you feel any condemnation, it is from your conscience, and not from God. You don’t need to act holy, as Jesus gave you His spirit when you got born again, which was created in true holiness. But if you truly love Jesus, you will try your best to be holy, as He is holy (1 Peter 1:16).
